title: 第849章 传承地图第848章 噬魔尸的击杀
lines: “好了。”李骏缓缓从地上站起身，拍了拍身上的尘土。
回想刚才，还是很凶险的。他一直隐忍着噬魔尸不发，为的就是一个时机，但是也没想到，对方的神魂攻击的符宝这么厉害，差点自己就扛不过去。
他事后回想，又觉得不是雷魂斩的功劳，思索无果，便暂时搁置。
断裂的古木横七竖八倒在地上，地面布满刀痕与焦黑雷击留下的坑洞。
空气中弥漫着浓重的血腥味，还有元婴修士陨落后残留的灵力波动。
那头元婴妖兽鹫鹍正被一柄灵剑死死钉住。
双翼断裂，鳞甲崩碎，鲜血顺着岩壁不断流淌。
刚才还威风凛凛、凶神恶煞的妖兽，如今看上去比路边被雨淋湿的野狗还要狼狈。
李骏收起黑斩，朝着那边走去。
“今天这么一闹，我们也有理由回城复命了，还有一只化形妖兽，过去瞧瞧。”
丰泽捂着伤口也跟着跑。
“滚一边去，又不是你杀的，还惦记妖丹！”
“妖丹算什么，这肉才是鲜美，净化一下炖了吃，大补！”
“你都快死了，还惦记口舌之福！”
“废话，我都快死了，还不能吃点好的？”
众人七嘴八舌围了过去。
被钉在山壁上的鹫鹍听得浑身发抖。
它发现眼前这些人看自己的眼神，根本不像看活物。
更像是在看一锅即将下锅的肉。
content_en:
"Okay." Li Jun slowly stood up from the ground and patted the dust on his body.
Thinking back to just now, it was still very dangerous. He had been holding back the Demon-Eating Corpse just for an opportunity, but he never expected that the talisman attacked by the opponent's soul was so powerful that he almost couldn't withstand it.
When he thought about it later, he felt that it was not the Thunder Soul Slash's fault, so his thoughts were fruitless, so he put it aside for the time being.
The surrounding woods were a mess.
Broken ancient trees fell to the ground in a mess, and the ground was covered with knife marks and charred holes left by lightning strikes.
The air was filled with a strong smell of blood, as well as the residual spiritual power fluctuations after the death of the Nascent Soul cultivator.
On the mountain wall in the distance.
The Nascent Soul Monster Vulture was being pinned tightly by a spiritual sword.
The wings were broken, the scales were shattered, and blood continued to flow along the rock wall.
The monster that was majestic and ferocious just now now looks even more embarrassed than a wild dog soaked by the rain on the roadside.
Li Jun put away the black chop and walked over there.
"With all the fuss today, we have reason to return to the city to recover. There is also a transformed monster. Let's go and take a look."
Everyone's eyes suddenly lit up.
Nascent Soul Monster!
This is full of treasures.
Han Xu was the first to rush over.
Fengze covered his wound and ran along.
"Quick, quick! Don't let it die!"
"The demon pill is mine!"
"Go away, you weren't the one who killed me, and you were still thinking about the demon pill!"
"What's the demon pill? This meat is delicious. Purify it and stew it. It's a great tonic!"
“You’re almost dead, and you’re still thinking about the blessings of your tongue!”
"Nonsense, I'm almost dead, can't I have something good to eat?"
Everyone gathered around him talking.
The vulture that was nailed to the mountain wall shivered all over.
It discovered that the eyes of the people in front of it looked at it, not like they were looking at living creatures at all.
It's more like looking at a pot of meat about to be cooked.
Fengze looked at it up and down.
"This monster is pretty good."
Han Xu nodded seriously.
"It's really good."
Fengze licked his lips.
"It's ready to stew."
Han Xu added:
"The Nascent Soul Monster is a great supplement."
Someone next to me answered.
"Bake the wings and eat them."
"The demon pill can be sold to the War Order."
"Take the scale armor to refine the weapon."
"Bone soup."
"Demon bone soaking wine."
The more the group discussed, the more excited they became.
Jiu Kun almost cried on the spot.
Are you dividing the spoils?
Or dismemberment?
title_en: Chapter 849: Heritage Map Chapter 848: The Killing of the Demon-Eating Corpse
